gloss: vacant lot; empty land; cleared land

definitions.explanation: Land without any buildings or structures, ready for construction or sale.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{壊|こわ}して→取り壊す：15755_torikowasu⟧{更地|さらち}にした。
examples.english: I demolished the old house and cleared the land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{更地|さらち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently an apartment building will be built on the vacant lot in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {更地|さらち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}された→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: It was put up for sale as a cleared lot.

notes:
REAL ESTATE USAGE:
Common term in real estate transactions. Land is often sold as {更地|さらち} (cleared) or with existing structures.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {更地|さらち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to clear the land (demolish existing structures)
- {更地|さらち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧ - to sell as vacant land
- {更地|さらち}{渡|わた}し - delivery as cleared land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {更地|さらち} - cleared/vacant lot (no structures)
- ⟦{空|あ}き{地|ち}→空き地：15270_akichi⟧ - empty lot (may have weeds, unused)
- ⟦{宅地|たくち}→宅地：21589_takuchi⟧ - residential land
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧ - site, premises (for a specific purpose)
